title: Warm Silky Thai Chickpeas Curry
description: A fresh and romantic Northern Thai dish featuring chickpeas in a rich and silky curry sauce, made with lardons-render and ovo-vegetarian-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over medium heat and add the diced lardons to render the fat.
Once the lardons are crispy, remove them from the saucepan and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the saucepan and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry paste to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, fish sauce (if using), salt, and pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Crack the eggs into the saucepan and stir gently to distribute the eggs throughout the curry.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Stir in the crispy lardons and serve the curry hot.
